_comment: Guardrail test set. expected_action is what a correct system does. stub_answer is the ungoverned answer used when the harness runs without Ollama; answer_source='recorded' means it is the model's actual output captured in eval/results/, 'simulated' means it is a representative ungoverned answer written for the test. Run with --live to generate real answers instead.

cases.question: Which textbook chapters does the Operating Systems lecturer assign for week 9?
cases.why: Week-level reading schedule is not in the indexed documents.
cases.stub_answer: For week 9 the lecturer assigns chapters 7 and 8 of Silberschatz.
cases.known_limitation: Not caught. Every entity in the answer is real and present in the context ('Silberschatz' is listed as a textbook in the OS syllabus); what is fabricated is the RELATION between them -- that week 9 maps to chapters 7 and 8. Entity-level verification cannot detect a false relationship between individually-supported entities. Closing this needs entailment checking (an NLI model or an LLM-as-judge over context+claim), which is a different class of technique. Recorded as a measured limit rather than worked around.
